newsitem.title: CANADA: World Wide Minerals to place warrants.
newsitem.headline: World Wide Minerals to place warrants.

text.p: World Wide Minerals Ltd said on Friday it proposed to issue 15 to 20 million special warrants at C$1.25 each through a private placement in Canada and the United Kingdom for net proceeds of C$17.625 million to C$23.5 million.
World Wide Minerals said each special warrant would be exchangeable at no additional consideration into one unit consisting of one common share and 1/2 of a common share purchase warrant.

It said each full common share purchase warrant is to be exercisable into one common share at a price of C$1.75 per share for 12 months from the date of issue and then at C$2.00 per share for a further 12 months.
Closing is set for mid-October, the company said.
Net proceeds will be assist World Wide Minerals in implementing its Tselinny uranium mining project in Kazakstan and for exploration and development of its mineral properties.
World Wide Minerals has about 27.7 million common shares outstanding, which would increase to 47.7 million if the maximum issue is completed.
